disqualifier_matrix.test: The route restates RG, OS, or Wilson requirements without a new representation object or theorem.
The representation loses gauge covariance, reflection positivity, nontriviality, or same-theory continuum data.
A cited constructive/RG theorem already supplies the same representation theorem under the same assumptions.

explicit_unknowns: Which representation object is strictly better than existing Wilson, Schwinger, RG, or OS formulations.
Which target commitment the representation makes cheaper without moving proof debt elsewhere.
Which falsifier would kill the route after one contract-writing pass.
gap_statement: The literature-aware gap is an efficient representation that simultaneously preserves gauge covariance, reflection positivity, continuum limiting data, and a nontrivial spectral carrier. The current workflow names this ambition but has not yet isolated the representation that makes the coupled requirements easier.
mathematical_or_physical_object: Representation morphisms over gauge-invariant observable families, regulator/RG maps, Schwinger-function coherence, and OS spectral-transfer data.
novelty_boundary: Novelty would lie in a concrete representation theorem or counterexample, not in renaming standard constructive-QFT or RG obligations as representational dynamics.

physics_or_field_impact.claim: A successful representation could change how YM existence, nontriviality, and mass-gap transfer are jointly understood.
physics_or_field_impact.evidence: It aims at gauge-invariant observables, RG/regulator coherence, OS reconstruction, and spectral data at once.
physics_or_field_impact.missing: No concrete representation theorem yet distinguishes it from a declarative overlay.

relevance_threshold.criterion: Invest only after the representation names preserved objects, primitive operations, invariants, and a falsifier.
relevance_threshold.evidence: The route could change the proof language around several Clay gates, but the efficient-representation requirement is still underdetermined.

smallest_honest_claim: A representational-dynamics route is worth broad investment only if it identifies a new efficient representation that preserves gauge-invariant observables, same-theory limits, OS positivity, and nontriviality witnesses better than the current Wilson/RG language.
